title: Romanticism & the Sublime
description: Nature at its most awe-inspiring, and the human drama set against it.

items.title: Distant View of Niagara Falls
items.description_narrative: Thomas Cole's Distant View of Niagara Falls, painted in 1830 with oil on wood panel, presents a sweeping vista of the iconic natural wonder. This work exemplifies Cole's profound engagement with the American landscape, often imbued with a sense of the sublime and picturesque.
items.tags: landscape, American art, romanticism, sublime, nature, Niagara Falls, oil painting

items.title: New England Scenery
items.cultural_context: Hudson River School, American Romanticism, 19th Century American
items.description_narrative: Thomas Cole's 'New England Scenery' captures the wild grandeur of the American landscape. This 1839 oil on canvas work exemplifies the romantic vision of nature central to Cole's artistic output.
items.tags: landscape, american art, hudson river school, romanticism, 19th century, nature, sublime

items.title: The Good Shepherd
items.medium: Lithograph on white wove plate paper
items.description_narrative: This lithograph by Thomas Cole, titled "The Good Shepherd" and created in 1849, likely portrays a traditional religious theme. The work, rendered on white wove plate paper, evokes a sense of spiritual guidance within a serene landscape.
items.tags: religious, pastoral, romanticism, allegorical, 19th century, american art, lithography

items.title: Portrait of John D. Rockefeller
items.medium: Wood engraving on cream China paper, tipped onto ivory wove paper
items.description_narrative: This wood engraving by Timothy Cole depicts a portrait of the prominent American industrialist John D. Rockefeller. Created in 1921, the work demonstrates Cole's masterful technique in printmaking, capturing the subject with intricate detail.
items.tags: portrait, john d. rockefeller, industrialist, wood engraving, printmaking, american art, 20th century

items.title: A Friendly Warning
items.description_narrative: This oil on canvas, titled 'A Friendly Warning,' presents a narrative scene inviting viewer contemplation. The artist, Thomas Hicks, utilized traditional painting techniques to convey the depicted interaction.
items.tags: painting, 19th century, american art, narrative, figurative, oil painting

items.title: Capture of the Tripoli by the Enterprise
items.description_narrative: This historical painting by Thomas Birch depicts the dramatic naval engagement between the USS Enterprise and the Tripolitan ship Tripoli. Rendered in oil on canvas, it captures a pivotal moment from the First Barbary War.
items.tags: naval, historical, marine, early american, war, 19th century, dramatic

items.title: Pergola with Oranges
items.medium: Oil on paper, mounted on canvas
items.description_narrative: Thomas Fearnley's 'Pergola with Oranges' depicts a sun-drenched architectural structure adorned with citrus fruits. This oil painting on paper, later mounted on canvas, captures a serene moment through its vibrant depiction of light and nature.
items.tags: pergola, oranges, garden, romanticism, landscape, picturesque, vibrant

items.title: Coming Squall (Nahant Beach with a Summer Shower)
items.cultural_context: Early American Landscape Painting, American Romanticism
items.medium: Oil on canvas mounted on cradled panel
items.description_narrative: This oil painting captures the dramatic moment of a summer squall approaching Nahant Beach, showcasing the powerful forces of nature. Dark, heavy clouds loom over an agitated sea, conveying the impending weather event with striking realism.
items.tags: landscape, seascape, storm, nature, romanticism, early american, dramatic

items.title: Apollo and Marsyas
items.description_narrative: This painting depicts the mythological contest between the god Apollo and the satyr Marsyas, a narrative often explored in art to symbolize the conflict between order and chaos or divine and earthly music. The work, rendered in oil on panel, captures a moment from this dramatic ancient Greek story.
items.tags: mythology, classical, German art, painting, narrative, late 19th century, symbolist

items.title: Study for "William Rush Carving His Allegorical Figure of the Schuylkill River"
items.medium: Oil on canvas mounted on board
items.description_narrative: This oil on canvas study by Thomas Eakins depicts American sculptor William Rush at work. Rush is shown meticulously carving his allegorical figure of the Schuylkill River in his Philadelphia studio.
items.tags: realism, american art, portraiture, sculpture, studio scene, 19th century, preparatory study

items.title: Summit of the Sierras
items.medium: Gouache over graphite, on cream laid paper
items.description_narrative: Thomas Moran's 'Summit of the Sierras' masterfully captures the rugged grandeur of the American West using gouache over graphite. This work vividly portrays the majestic peaks of the Sierra Nevada mountains, reflecting the sublime beauty of the natural landscape.
items.tags: landscape, american west, sierra nevada, mountains, gouache, romanticism, sublime

items.title: Portrait of Mary Adeline Williams
items.description_narrative: Thomas Eakins's 1899 oil on canvas depicts Mary Adeline Williams with a characteristic directness and psychological insight. His work is celebrated for its unvarnished realism, capturing the sitter's individual presence with a precise eye.
items.tags: portrait, realism, american art, oil painting, late 19th century, psychological, contemplative

items.title: Riter Fitzgerald
items.description_narrative: Thomas Eakins's 1895 portrait of Riter Fitzgerald exemplifies his commitment to capturing individual presence rather than idealizing his subjects. Through a muted palette and direct gaze, Eakins reveals a quiet intensity in the sitter.
items.tags: portrait, american realism, oil painting, male subject, 19th century, psychological, muted

items.title: Sarah Dupont
items.description_narrative: Thomas Gainsborough was a prominent English portrait and landscape painter of the 18th century. This oil painting captures a likeness, reflecting the artist's characteristic elegant style and mastery of brushwork.
items.tags: portraiture, 18th century, British art, oil painting, elegant, aristocratic, Georgian era

items.title: Landscape with Dog
items.description_narrative: Thomas Doughty's "Landscape with Dog" depicts a serene natural scene, characteristic of early American landscape painting. Executed in oil on composition board in 1832, it invites contemplation of an untamed yet inviting wilderness.
items.tags: landscape, american landscape, nature, dog, serene, oil painting, romanticism

items.title: Concerto Spirituale
items.medium: Pen and brush with brown wash, over traces of graphite, on ivory wove paper
items.description_narrative: Thomas Rowlandson's *Concerto Spirituale* presents a lively scene rendered with pen and brush and brown wash. Created around 1775/80, this work showcases the artist's distinctive style, characterized by expressive lines and dynamic compositions.
items.tags: drawing, satire, humor, music, Georgian era, British art, wash technique

items.title: A Woodman Seated on a Bundle of Faggots
items.medium: Black chalk with stumping, heightened with touches of white gouache and traces of white chalk, on buff laid paper
items.description_narrative: This drawing depicts a lone woodman seated on a bundle of faggots, his posture suggesting a moment of rest. Gainsborough masterfully uses black chalk with stumping and white heightening to create a sense of texture and depth, highlighting the rustic nature of his subject.
items.tags: woodman, rural life, figure study, 18th century, british art, drawing, chalk, contemplative

items.title: Mrs. Klapp (Anna Milnor)
items.description_narrative: Thomas Sully's 1814 oil on canvas presents a portrait of Mrs. Klapp, also known as Anna Milnor. This work exemplifies the artist's refined approach to capturing individual likeness through the medium of paint.
items.tags: portrait, oil painting, American art, 19th century, realism, woman, Thomas Sully

items.title: Dr. Joseph Klapp
items.description_narrative: Painted by Thomas Sully in 1814, this oil on canvas depicts Dr. Joseph Klapp. The work serves as a formal portrait, representative of American painting from the early 19th century.
items.tags: portrait, oil painting, American, 19th century, formal, doctor, realism

items.title: Isabella Wolff
items.description_narrative: Sir Thomas Lawrence's oil on canvas portrait depicts Isabella Wolff, capturing her refined presence with remarkable detail. Created between 1803 and 1815, this work exemplifies the artist's celebrated ability to convey character and elegance through his brushwork.
items.tags: portrait, woman, romanticism, british art, oil painting, 19th century, elegance, refined

items.title: Infantry Armor and Targe (Shield)
items.description_narrative: This formidable infantry armor set, complete with a matching targe shield, showcases the protective craftsmanship of the late 16th century. Crafted from steel with gilding, brass, and leather, it represents the defensive equipment used by soldiers of the period.
items.tags: armor, targe, shield, infantry, protective gear, steel, historical, european

items.title: Field Armor
items.description_narrative: This Field Armor exemplifies the protective gear worn during the early to mid-16th century, expertly crafted from steel and leather. Designed for combat, its articulated plates provided vital defense while allowing for a degree of mobility on the battlefield.
items.tags: armor, steel, leather, protective, military, renaissance, historical, combat

items.title: Composite Boy's Armor for Foot Tournament at the Barriers
items.description_narrative: This composite boy's armor, crafted from steel, brass, and leather around 1600, was designed for a foot tournament at the barriers. It represents specialized protective gear for ceremonial combat during the Early Modern period.
items.tags: armor, historical, tournament, protective gear, steel, european, early modern, ceremonial

items.title: Three-Quarter Field Armor of Anime Construction
items.agent_name: Workshop of Michel Witz, the Younger
items.description_narrative: This three-quarter field armor, made of steel and leather, provided robust protection in a style described as Anime construction. Crafted in the workshop of Michel Witz the Younger around 1560, this impressive suit was designed for use in battle.
items.tags: armor, steel, leather, 16th century, military, protection, renaissance

items.title: Infantry Armor
items.medium: Steel, iron, leather and black paint
items.description_narrative: This formidable infantry armor, crafted from steel, iron, and leather, provided crucial protection for soldiers during the mid-16th century. Its robust construction and black painted finish reflect the practical demands and aesthetic of military equipment from that era.
items.tags: armor, military, 16th century, protective gear, steel, historical, craftsmanship

items.title: Composite Armor for Heavy Cavalry (Cuirassier)
items.description_narrative: This composite armor for a cuirassier offers robust protection for a heavy cavalry soldier. Crafted from steel, leather, and paint, it provided essential defense during the early to mid-17th century.
items.tags: armor, cavalry, steel, protective gear, 17th century, military history, historical artifact

items.title: Half Armor
items.description_narrative: This robust half-armor, meticulously crafted from steel, offered crucial protection for a warrior during the mid-to-late 16th century. Its functional design and expert metallurgy reflect the advanced military technology and craftsmanship of its era.
items.tags: armor, steel, 16th century, military, protective, craftsmanship, historical

items.title: Landscape in the Style of Ancient Masters: colophon by Lu Hui, dated 1912
items.creation_date: Ming dynasty (1368–1644), album dated 1642, colophon dated 1912
items.date_display: Ming dynasty (1368–1644), album dated 1642, colophon dated 1912
items.description_narrative: This ink on paper album leaf depicts a landscape in the style of ancient masters, reflecting a reverence for historical artistic traditions. Originally an album dated 1642 from the Ming dynasty, the work includes a colophon by artist Lu Hui, added in 1912.
items.tags: landscape, ink painting, album leaf, Ming dynasty, Chinese art, traditional, contemplative

items.title: Windsor Armchair
items.description_narrative: This Windsor Armchair, crafted from a combination of tulipwood, maple, oak, and ash, exemplifies the robust yet elegant domestic furniture of its era. Created by J. M. Hasbrouck between 1752 and 1787, it showcases the detailed construction characteristic of 18th-century craftsmanship.
items.tags: furniture, windsor chair, armchair, wooden, 18th century, american, craftsmanship

items.title: Fishing Boats with Hucksters Bargaining for Fish
items.description_narrative: Joseph Mallord William Turner’s "Fishing Boats with Hucksters Bargaining for Fish" captures a dynamic maritime scene. The artwork showcases his distinctive use of light and atmosphere to depict the bustling activity surrounding fishing vessels.
items.tags: seascape, marine, romanticism, atmospheric, fishing, boats, 19th century

items.title: A Shipwreck
items.description_narrative: Charles Turner's mezzotint captures the dramatic intensity of a shipwreck, highlighting the destructive power of nature. This print on ivory laid paper showcases the artist's skill in rendering light and shadow to convey the tumultuous scene.
items.tags: shipwreck, disaster, marine, mezzotint, print, romanticism, dramatic

items.title: Frederick Douglass
items.description_narrative: This daguerreotype captures a striking portrait of Frederick Douglass, the eminent abolitionist and orator. Created by Samuel J. Miller between 1847 and 1852, the image reflects the powerful presence of a pivotal figure in American history.
items.tags: frederick douglass, portrait, daguerreotype, early photography, abolitionist, historical, 19th century

items.title: Valley of Aosta: Snowstorm, Avalanche, and Thunderstorm
items.description_narrative: This dramatic oil painting by J.M.W. Turner captures the overwhelming power of nature within the rugged Alpine landscape of the Aosta Valley. The scene dynamically combines a snowstorm, an avalanche, and a thunderstorm, illustrating the sublime forces at play.
items.tags: romanticism, landscape, snowstorm, avalanche, thunderstorm, sublime, dramatic, nature

items.title: Pair of Flintlock Pistols
items.description_narrative: This elegant pair of flintlock pistols showcases intricate craftsmanship, fashioned from walnut, brass, and gold. Crafted by J. J. Behr between 1700 and 1730, these weapons exemplify early 18th-century decorative artistry.
items.tags: weaponry, firearms, decorative arts, craftsmanship, 18th century, walnut, brass, gold

items.title: An April Shower: A View from Binsey Ferry Near Oxford, Looking Towards Port Meadow and Godstow
items.medium: Watercolor over graphite, with scraping, on cream wove paper
items.description_narrative: William Turner captured a fleeting moment of natural drama in "An April Shower," depicting a view near Oxford with approaching rain. This 1842 watercolor over graphite, with scraping, showcases his innovative approach to light and atmosphere.
items.tags: landscape, weather, rain, oxford, watercolor, british, 19th century

items.title: Study for "An Aragonese Smuggler"
items.description_narrative: This oil on canvas is a preparatory study for a larger work, focusing on the figure of an Aragonese smuggler. It provides insight into the artist's process in developing a narrative scene.
items.tags: study, smuggler, aragonese, oil painting, figure study, 19th century art, preparatory work
